title: Apple and Meta team up to make Muse AI model run on Mac computers
description: Meta released Muse Spark Open, which it describes as the most capable U.S. open-weight model to date, an 816-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model. Apple and Meta are partnering so developers can run it locally on two to four Mac Studio machines.

title: Gemini 4 Argon is now rolling out to Google's Antigravity for AI Pro subscribers
description: Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Argon support in Antigravity, its AI coding tool, for AI Pro subscribers. The release brings the new Gemini 4 model family to developer workflows.

title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
description: Anthropic is giving six researchers from the evaluation nonprofit METR employee-level access to its systems. The arrangement is meant to allow deeper independent evaluation of frontier models.

title: ServiceNow adds AI agent controls and employee automation tools
description: ServiceNow launched AI Passport, a signed credential that defines what an AI agent is permitted to do, along with expanded EmployeeWorks automation tools. Some features arrive later this quarter.

title: Nvidia, AMD, Dell sink in global tech rout on AI funding worries
description: Shares of major AI and semiconductor companies fell sharply amid concerns about AI funding. CNBC reports the 20 most valuable global AI and chip stocks have lost over $1 trillion in value so far this week.

title: White House AI Task Force to Hold First Meeting on Thursday
description: Bloomberg reports a new White House AI task force is set to hold its first meeting on Thursday. The group is expected to shape U.S. policy on artificial intelligence.
